concepts.name: input shift in reference standard deviations (Glass's Δ)
concepts.slide: Definition — input shift, in reference standard deviations
concepts.formula: Δ_t = |mean_t − mean_ref| / s_ref, with s_ref the sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the reference period

concepts.name: the fixed-reference shift series
concepts.slide: Definition — the fixed reference against the moving baseline
concepts.formula: fixed: Δ_t = |mean_t − mean_ref| / s_ref, one reference period held still

concepts.name: the moving-baseline shift series
concepts.slide: Definition — the fixed reference against the moving baseline
concepts.formula: moving: Δ_t = |mean_t − mean_{t−1}| / s_{t−1}, the yardstick redrawn every day

concepts.name: the baseline that goes blind
concepts.slide: Definition — the fixed reference against the moving baseline
concepts.formula: blind: Δ_t returns to the quiet floor after a step, though mean_t ≠ mean_ref throughout

concepts.name: a breach of the threshold, by day number
concepts.slide: Definition — a breach, and the day it happened on
concepts.formula: over(Δ, τ) = { t : Δ_t ≥ τ }, reported as day numbers, with day 1 at position 0

concepts.name: the model's own output rate
concepts.slide: Definition — the three levels, and what each costs
concepts.formula: r_t = (1/n_t) Σ_i ŷ_{t,i}

concepts.name: the three levels of monitoring
concepts.slide: Definition — the three levels, and what each costs
concepts.formula: level 1 = Δ_t on the inputs, cost 0 · level 2 = output rate r_t = (1/n_t) Σ_i ŷ_{t,i}, cost 0 · level 3 = accuracy on m bought labels per day, cost m labels

concepts.name: bought truth: a seeded sample without replacement
concepts.slide: Definition — bought truth and its Wilson interval
concepts.formula: S ⊂ D drawn without replacement, |S| = min(m, |D|), successes k = Σ_{i ∈ S} 1[ŷ_i = y_i]

concepts.name: the Wilson interval on a bought share
concepts.slide: Definition — bought truth and its Wilson interval
concepts.formula: (k + z²/2)/(n + z²) ± z/(n + z²) · √( k(n − k)/n + z²/4 ), z = 1.96 at 95 per cent

concepts.name: when a level has moved
concepts.slide: Definition — when a level has moved, and why overlap is not a test
concepts.formula: moved(level) ⟺ |later − earlier| ≥ tolerance, with tolerances 0.10 reference standard deviations for the inputs, 0.05 for the output rate and 0.05 for bought accuracy

concepts.name: covariate shift, concept drift and prior shift
concepts.slide: Definition — covariate shift, concept drift and prior shift
concepts.formula: covariate shift: P_ref(X) ≠ P_cur(X) with P(Y | X) unchanged · concept drift: P(Y | X) changes · prior shift: P(Y) changes with P(X | Y) unchanged

concepts.name: truth bought by segment, on a stated budget
concepts.slide: Definition — buying truth by segment, and what the allocation costs
concepts.formula: by group g: k_g successes of n_g checked, with Σ_g n_g = budget · uniform: one draw from the period, n_g as the traffic falls · stratified: n_g = budget / |G| for every g, whatever its share of the traffic

concepts.name: which group the model got worse for
concepts.slide: Definition — buying truth by segment, and what the allocation costs
concepts.formula: moved(g) ⟺ |accuracy_later(g) − accuracy_earlier(g)| ≥ tolerance, over the groups present in both periods

concepts.name: the quiet floor
concepts.slide: Definition — the quiet floor and the lowest safe threshold
concepts.formula: floor = max_{1 ≤ t ≤ q} Δ_t over the quiet days, day 1 at position 0

concepts.name: the lowest safe threshold
concepts.slide: Definition — the quiet floor and the lowest safe threshold
concepts.formula: τ* = min { τ ∈ C : τ > floor }, and None when no candidate clears the floor

concepts.name: confirmation and the cooldown
concepts.slide: Definition — confirmation, the cooldown, and what they cost
concepts.formula: run_t = run_{t−1} + 1 if Δ_t ≥ τ else 0; page at t ⟺ run_t ≥ k and t ≥ p + c, p the last paging day

concepts.name: detection delay
concepts.slide: Definition — confirmation, the cooldown, and what they cost
concepts.formula: delay = first paging day − first breach, and −1 when the series never crosses

concepts.name: one shift series per watched column
concepts.slide: Definition — watching many columns: the family floor and the expected false alarms
concepts.formula: Δ_{c,t} = |mean_{c,t} − mean_{c,ref}| / s_{c,ref} for each watched column c, missing readings dropped

concepts.name: the family quiet floor
concepts.slide: Definition — watching many columns: the family floor and the expected false alarms
concepts.formula: floor_family = max_c max_{1 ≤ t ≤ q} Δ_{c,t}, the largest quiet-day movement any watched column makes

concepts.name: the alarms expected from nothing at all
concepts.slide: Definition — watching many columns: the family floor and the expected false alarms
concepts.formula: E[alarms] = m · α · d for m columns at a per-column level α over d days

concepts.name: the alert verdict: page, ticket or nothing
concepts.slide: Definition — the alert verdict: page, ticket or nothing
concepts.formula: verdict(evidence) = nothing if observed ≤ quiet_floor · page if level = outcome and truth has arrived · ticket otherwise, with a reason naming ≥ 2 of the quantities weighed

concepts.name: a run
concepts.slide: Definition — a run, and the retrain that logs it
concepts.formula: run = (parameters, data window, metrics, artefact, environment) recorded once and never edited; one retrain, one run

concepts.name: the gate and its margin
concepts.slide: Definition — the gate, and the margin it opens on
concepts.formula: promote ⟺ accuracy(candidate) ≥ accuracy(champion) + margin, both measured on gate days neither model was trained on, each model on its own feature list

concepts.name: the release verdict: promote, hold or roll back
concepts.slide: Definition — the release verdict: promote, hold or roll back
concepts.formula: verdict = roll back if the released model is worse than the one it replaced · hold if the candidate's number came from days it was trained on · promote if candidate − champion ≥ max(margin, Wilson half-width) · hold otherwise

concepts.name: release by alias
concepts.slide: Definition — release by alias, and rollback
concepts.formula: release(v): alias champion ↦ v, the artefact never overwritten

concepts.name: rollback as the same move reversed
concepts.slide: Definition — release by alias, and rollback
concepts.formula: rollback: alias champion ↦ v_previous, the same move reversed, with the history append-only

concepts.name: the model signature
concepts.slide: Definition — the model signature
concepts.formula: signature = (column names, types, order) inferred at logging and enforced at predict: a reorder is corrected, a rename or an absence is refused

concepts.name: the feedback loop
concepts.slide: Definition — the feedback loop
concepts.formula: the model's own decisions enter the data it is next trained on: D_{t+1} = f(D_t, model_t), so what "normal" means is partly the previous model's doing
